content.short: Talis Protocol is the premier NFT marketplace on Injective specializing in bridging physical art with digital tokens.
content.description: Talis Protocol is the leading decentralized NFT marketplace and creator hub built natively for the Injective blockchain. Designed to empower artists, the platform specializes in the tokenization of physical artworks, allowing creators to bridge traditional media with the digital economy. Talis serves as the primary liquidity hub for major Injective collections, providing a seamless experience with sub-second finality. Powered by the TALIS token, the protocol features robust governance and professional-grade marketplace tools such as advanced filtering and floor price tracking.
